occupations.title: Occupations
occupations.description: List of occupations to look up: [{ "socCode": "15-1252", "stateCode"?: "TX" }]. socCode is the 6-digit Standard Occupational Classification code (find yours at bls.gov/soc). Omit stateCode for national data, or use a two-letter USPS state code for state-level data.

apiKey.title: BLS API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional free registration key from bls.gov/developers, raises the daily request limit and historical range. Not required for small batches.
